name: membrane
rationale: sole support is the ECO:0000255 TRANSMEM 20..40 call; every ortholog is annotated as a soluble ER-lumenal protein and AlphaFold favours a cleaved signal peptide 5.5:1

name: endoplasmic reticulum
rationale: ortholog-based inference is independent of the topology question and is unaffected either way

name: endoplasmic reticulum lumen
lead: ADD as ISS/IBA lead, requires curator verification
rationale: S. cerevisiae Sil1 (Q08199) and human SIL1 (Q9H173) are both annotated ER lumen; supported here by homology and AlphaFold but not by any pombe experiment

name: intrinsic component of endoplasmic reticulum membrane
rationale: would make the prediction-derived membrane claim more specific than the evidence allows

name: adenyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity
rationale: orthologous NEF activity shown structurally for yeast Sil1 on BiP (PMID 21675960); unaffected by topology

name: SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane, translocation
rationale: describes the translocation pathway Sil1 supports via BiP rather than a direct Sil1 activity; downstream of NEF function
